A [[Human/Legends|human]] Raydonian '''mother''' lived in a [[Raydonian settlement/Legends|Raydonian settlement]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and his brother, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], visited the [[Raydonian settlement/Legends|Raydonian settlement]]. The two sought to attract the attention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the man who reduced Maul to his current state, by [[Massacre on Raydonia/Legends|slaughtering]] the entire population of the village, including this woman, who saw the Zabraks' [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|ship]] approaching and, mistaking it for a supply ship, sent children to it.<ref name="Revenge" />

Obi-Wan Kenobi later walked past the woman's corpse during his search for Maul.<ref name="Revenge" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]," this woman, credited as "Raydonia Mother," was voiced by [[Nika Futterman]], who also voiced [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in the series.<ref name="Revenge" />
